other_failure_modes.description: When parsing dates with two-digit years, pandas' `to_datetime` by default assumes years '00'-'68' are in the 2000s. This causes older dates (e.g., a movie from 1968) to be incorrectly parsed as future dates (2068), significantly distorting temporal features.

summary: The agent implements a solid, leak-free pipeline with good feature engineering and categorical processing. However, it relies on an unweighted ensemble, evaluates on a single random split which ignores the dataset's temporal nature, and suffers from a common pandas date-parsing bug that maps 20th-century dates into the future.
